newsitem.title: INDIA: IMF head urges India to focus on infrastructure.
newsitem.headline: IMF head urges India to focus on infrastructure.

text.p: International Monetary Fund managing director Michel Camdessus on Wednesday urged India to reallocate resources in favour of infrastructure investment, especially in the agricultural sector.

"We believe it would be important to have a better balance of fiscal expenditure through a shift in favour of infrastructure investment, particularly in agriculture in order to ensure a high growth potential for the agricultural sector," he told a news conference in the Indian capital.
"There is immense need for further investment in the agricultural sector," he said.

Camdessus recommended that India open up the banking and insurance sectors even more. "Also on the list is privatisation, which could now be speeded up in view of the very solid position of your stock markets," he said.
The IMF chief also urged India to remove quantitative restrictions on imports of consumer goods.
